note: Statistics on the released J2 set (1,521 departments) with each rerun's v3 values in place of the evaluated ones; the reruns' department values are not released; full precision.

exante.note: all released departments with a baseline; the baseline stands in where the rerun has no value or the department is withheld

levels.note: bias and MAE of reruns by historical level (baseline divided by the multiplier total), on the rerun-covered part of J2

vintage.note: pre-deadline inputs with the Fractional (marginal) cutoff and with other fixed weights
